scope: Only the approved main experiment; vocabulary/data/SAT ablations remain deferred

equal_validation_opportunity.execution: Three independent scratch trajectories per method to epoch 300; inspect epoch 100 and 300; do not restart or alter the schedule at 100
equal_validation_opportunity.selection_scope: One shared pilot excluding every final target structure; select one global setting per method and freeze it across all final cases/seeds
equal_validation_opportunity.objective: Mean complete-sequence NLL across unique original validation formulas, within each method only
equal_validation_opportunity.final_fit: Reinitialize for each final case/seed, exclude that case target/equivalents, train for the globally selected epochs/LR, then discover target PDEs
equal_validation_opportunity.retries: Divergence records a failed candidate; any broader grid requires the same expansion for every method

data_exposure: Match raw formula IDs/order and effective batch of formulas; record actual token work and timing
compute_fairness: Same recipe and equal candidate counts do not imply equal FLOPs or wall time; report costs without claiming IsoFLOPs
